exact_section.heading: Standard III — continual evaluation and recovery record
exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports documented oxygenation, ventilation, circulation, consciousness, temperature, pain or other recovery observations, and use of a recovery score where appropriate.

exact_source_references.source_document_title: Standards for Postanesthesia Care

exact_section.heading: Standards IV–V — discharge responsibility and criteria

exact_section.heading: Patient assessment and monitoring during recovery
exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports periodic documented respiratory, cardiovascular, neurologic or mental, temperature, pain, nausea or vomiting, hydration, urine-output, drainage, and bleeding observations.

exact_source_references.source_document_title: Practice Guidelines for Postanesthetic Care

exact_section.heading: Discharge assessment and documentation

exact_section.heading: Pre-assessment — indication, intended aim, and procedure context

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 16–17 — monitoring and complete recovery

exact_source_references.source_document_title: British Society of Gastroenterology guidelines on sedation in gastrointestinal endoscopy

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 18–19 — suitability for discharge and instructions
exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports formal documented discharge assessment, recovery from sedation, absence of complications, vital and respiratory status, pain or discomfort review, procedure-appropriate instructions, contact information, and activity restrictions after sedation.
